note: Aussies-in-the-NBA — the curated half of a hybrid. /api/aussies?league=nba scans every ESPN roster for birthPlace.country == Australia AND matches these names (ESPN drops the birthplace on some internationals, Giddey included). Names must match ESPN's fullName exactly. Players not on a roster simply don't render, so retired/unsigned entries are harmless. Order = display priority.

players.name: Josh Giddey
players.hook: The Boomers' playmaker and the face of Australian basketball in the NBA — a triple-double machine running Chicago's offence.

players.name: Dyson Daniels
players.hook: The Great Barrier Thief — the NBA's steals leader and Most Improved Player, Australia's best defender in the league.

players.name: Josh Green
players.hook: Boomers wing, elite defender and Olympic quarter-finalist — the connective piece every contender wants.

players.name: Jock Landale
players.hook: Boomers centre and NBL champion who forced his way into the league — the big-man insurance policy.

players.name: Johnny Furphy
players.hook: The 6'9" wing who went from Canberra to the lottery conversation in one college season.

players.name: Tyrese Proctor
players.hook: The Duke point guard, Boomers-eligible, drafted into Cleveland's contender.

players.name: Ben Simmons
players.hook: The former No. 1 pick and Rookie of the Year — Australia's most talented export, still one of the best passers alive.

players.name: Patty Mills
players.hook: The Boomers' captain and 2021 Olympic bronze medallist — an NBA champion and Australian basketball's spiritual leader.

players.name: Dante Exum
players.hook: The No. 5 pick who rebuilt his career in Europe and came back a starter — the comeback story.

players.name: Duop Reath
players.hook: From the Wildcats to an NBA rotation — the stretch-five who proved the NBL-to-NBA pathway works.

players.name: Matisse Thybulle
players.hook: US-born, Boomers-committed — the All-Defensive wing who chose the green and gold.

players.name: Joe Ingles
players.hook: The Boomers' greatest — thirteen NBA seasons of jokes, threes and winning plays.

players.name: Alex Toohey
players.hook: The Next Star who jumped from the Kings to the NBA — the newest Boomers wing.

players.name: Rocco Zikarsky
players.hook: The 7'3" teenager from the Bullets — the biggest Australian project since Bogut.

players.name: Lachlan Olbrich
players.hook: The NBL champion forward drafted straight into the league.

players.name: Kyrie Irving
players.hook: Yes, Melbourne-born — an NBA champion and one of the great ball-handlers, with an Australian passport to prove it.
